title: Quarterly Financial Analysis
subtitle: Q4 2024 — Revenue & Operations Summary
executive_summary: This report presents a comprehensive analysis of Q4 2024 financial performance. Revenue grew by 18.3% year-over-year, driven primarily by strong growth in the SaaS segment (+34%) and international expansion. Operating margins improved from 12.1% to 15.6%, reflecting successful cost optimization initiatives. Customer acquisition costs declined 8% while LTV increased 22%, signaling a favorable shift in unit economics. Key risks include FX headwinds in European markets and supply chain delays affecting hardware revenue.

insights.text: SaaS segment reached ₪2.9M in Q4, representing 60% of total revenue — up from 45% in Q4 2023. This structural shift is improving margin predictability and reducing revenue volatility.
Net Revenue Retention (NRR) reached 127%, meaning existing customers expanded their spending by 27% on average. This is a leading indicator of strong product-market fit.
US market launched in September 2024 with 87 enterprise customers acquired in Q4. Average deal size is 2.3x higher than the domestic market, though sales cycles are longer at ~90 days.
R&D headcount increased by 15 engineers while R&D as % of revenue declined from 28% to 24%, demonstrating improved engineering productivity and platform leverage.
EUR/ILS exchange rate fluctuations created a ₪180,000 headwind in European revenue. A natural hedging strategy is being evaluated for H1 2025.
Q1 2025 sales pipeline stands at ₪8.2M (3.2x coverage ratio). Enterprise pipeline grew 64% quarter-over-quarter, with 12 deals in final contract stages.
Infrastructure costs per customer declined 19% following migration to a multi-tenant architecture completed in October 2024. Full-year savings estimated at ₪420,000.
SOC 2 Type II certification obtained in December 2024, opening access to regulated enterprise verticals including financial services and healthcare.

sections.title: Revenue Breakdown by Segment
sections.content: Revenue diversification continued in Q4 2024 with SaaS subscriptions becoming the dominant revenue source. Hardware and professional services remained stable contributors while one-time license fees declined as planned.
bullet_points: SaaS Subscriptions: ₪2,892,000 (+34% YoY) — 60% of total revenue
Professional Services: ₪963,000 (+7% YoY) — 20% of total revenue
Hardware & Licenses: ₪723,000 (-5% YoY) — 15% of total revenue

sections.title: Strategic Priorities for Q1 2025
sections.content: Based on Q4 performance and market conditions, the following strategic initiatives have been prioritized for the upcoming quarter.
bullet_points: Close 3 enterprise deals currently in legal review with combined ACV of ₪1.8M
Launch AI-powered analytics module to drive expansion revenue in existing accounts
Hire 8 additional customer success managers to support NRR targets
Complete SOC 2 marketing campaign targeting financial services verticals
Evaluate Series B funding options with target close in Q2 2025
